# today_design_system

**Tag**: mobile, ui

## 简介

This is a package to import all the Today Design System widgets and constants to generate new Flutter projects based of it.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/xtminc/today-design-system-docs
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/today_design_system
